Your support is essential to the Discovery Arboretum. All funding for our grounds and programming comes from external sources, and your gift will ensure the arboretum has the resources it needs to deliver beautiful landscapes and exciting programs in the future. There are many options for giving that could appeal to you. 

**Give by credit card**  
[Make a donation online.](https://give.colostate.edu/campaigns/44294/donations/new?designation=heritagearboretum&){target="blank"}

**Give by check**  
To donate by mail, you can make the check payable to CSU Foundation with "Heritage Arboretum" in the memo line and mail it to the following address:  

College of Agricultural Sciences  
Attn: Peri Mueller  
1101 Campus Delivery  
Fort Collins, CO 80523

Contact the CSU Foundation at 970-491-7135 for other gift options, including bank wire transfer, stocks, securities, and planned gifts.
